convention.forward: +Z (barrel / throw-forward axis, same as character +Z forward)
convention.right: +X (same handedness as the character: the WeaponSocket / Hand.R side)
convention.origin: Grip marker. Long guns: the trigger-hand contact = WeaponSocket rest position (Hand.R joint). Throwables: the object centre / hold point.

markers.Muzzle: barrel or tube exit, +Z points downrange

convention.tracer_note: Tracer bullets are authored nose-forward on +X; rotate a tracer by +90 deg about Y (+X -> +Z) when spawning it at Muzzle.

usage: Hide the character Weapon slot (catalog modular slot "Weapon"), instance the weapon GLB as a child of WeaponSocket with characters[id].long_gun (identity), or for throwables as a child of a BoneAttachment3D on Hand.R with characters[id].throwable[weapon id]. WeaponSocket follows the animated Weapon bone, so long guns inherit every authored clip.

unassigned.weapon:molotov: No class in the library data throws a Molotov; enemy:fire carries a baked bottle. Any two-hand character can use it with the Throw_Grenade clip.
